items.title: The flat along the fibre freeness statement without the finite presentation hypothesis
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the finite type (as opposed to finite presentation) form of the freeness statement along a fibre: after an elementary etale neighbourhood of the point of the base there is an affine etale neighbourhood of the fibre on which the pulled back finite type module has free global sections (statement lines 3626-3649, tag 05L1). The proof is the same assembling argument as in the finite presentation case: apply the pointwise variant at the points of the quasi-compact fibre, pass to finitely many points, choose one dominating elementary etale neighbourhood, and then take the disjoint union of the base changed pieces, whose global sections are a direct sum of base changes of free modules. The assembling step is the substance, so the claim is H2.
